modern: No man will stop you from living according to the reason of your own nature: nothing will happen to you contrary to the reason of the universal nature.
original: No man will hinder thee from living according to the reason of thy own nature: nothing will happen to thee contrary to the reason of the universal nature.

explained.summary: No one can stop you living by your own reason, and nothing will happen to you that goes against the reason of the universe. Your character is always yours to direct, and whatever comes your way is part of the order of things. Between those two facts, there’s nothing left to fear.
